# PDF Export Dependencies

Locally bundled MIT-licensed browser builds (no runtime CDN):

- jsPDF 4.2.1, npm `jspdf@4.2.1`, https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF
- jsPDF-AutoTable 5.0.8, npm `jspdf-autotable@5.0.8`, https://github.com/simonbengtsson/jsPDF-AutoTable
- Noto Sans Regular, SIL OFL 1.1, https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/tree/ffebf8c1ee449e544955a7e813c54f9b73848eac/hinted/ttf/NotoSans

Original license files accompany each build. Only the PDF drawing and table APIs are used; HTML rendering and external image loading are not used.
